# Read a single GPR line from an HDF5 file

```r
.read_GPR_line_hdf5(dsn, name)
```

## Arguments

- `dsn`: (`character(1)`) Path to the HDF5 file.
- `name`: (`character(1)`) Line name (sub-group under `/lines/`).

## Returns

Object of class `GPR`.

## Description

Read a single GPR line from an HDF5 file
